business_summary: The Taiko Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Japan. It offers savings and internet-only deposit accounts; time deposit/regular savings; investment trusts; foreign currency deposits; public debts; financial product intermediary; automated asset management services; pension and endowment, whole life, long-term care, fire, and web-only insurance, as well as medical, cancer, dementia, income protection, and savings-type accident insurance; defined contribution pension plan; will trusts and estate settlement services; and inheritance procedure support services. The company also provides card, personal, car, educational, home renovation, business, reverse mortgage, and other loans; debit, credit, and cash cards; electronic money top-up and payment services; money transfer; tax payment; e-banking; internet investment trusts; ATM; pension payment; safe deposit box; point services; foreign currency delivery; web and pay-easy account transfer acceptance; international money transfer; and mail order services. In addition, it offers business support services, including SDGs support, advance, business matching and trade show, management consulting, subsidies and grants, recruitment, foreign exchange and overseas expansion support, and business self-assessment system services; industry-specific loan products; donation-type private placement bonds; office e-banking; NB center internet payment collection; electronic bill; farm banking; business succession support; and merger and acquisition related services. The company was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Nagaoka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Taiko Bank, Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본에서 다양한 은행 상품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 저축 및 인터넷 전용 예금 계좌를 제공합니다. 정기예금/정기적금; 투자 신탁; 외화예금; 공공 부채; 금융상품 중개업자; 자동화된 자산 관리 서비스; 연금 및 기부금, 종신보험, 장기요양보험, 화재보험, 웹전용보험은 물론 의료보험, 암보험, 치매보험, 소득보장보험, 저축성 상해보험 등 확정기여형 연금제도; 신탁 및 재산 정산 서비스; 및 상속절차 지원 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 또한 카드, 개인, 자동차, 교육, 주택 개조, 비즈니스, 역 모기지 및 기타 대출을 제공합니다. 직불카드, 신용카드, 현금카드; 전자화폐 충전 및 결제 서비스; 송금; 세금 납부; 전자금융; 인터넷 투자 신탁; ATM; 연금 지급; 안전 금고; 포인트 서비스; 외화배송; 웹 및 간편 계좌 이체 승인; 국제 송금; 및 우편 주문 서비스. 또한 SDGs 지원, 진출, 비즈니스 매칭 및 전시회, 경영 등 비즈니스 지원 서비스를 제공합니다.
